name: MEDICLIN Aktiengesellschaft
summary: MEDICLIN Aktiengesellschaft operates hospitals in Germany. The company operates through Post-Acute; Acute; and Nursing Care and Service segments. It offers medical services in the areas of neurology; psychosomatics; orthopedics; internal medicine; cardiology; oncology; geriatrics; psychiatry; otorhinolaryngology; cardiac medicine; rheumatology; gynecology; trauma, heart, and general surgeries; urology; and others. The company also provides services in the areas of ENT and acute outpatient services.
